 Man’s body recovered after being washed away in Soweto
 Flooding in Soweto. 
 Image Credits : 
 Supplied 
 SABC News 
 17 November 2026, 20:21 [SAST] 
 The body of a man believed to be in his 40s has been recovered in Dobsonville Extension 3, Soweto, after he was reportedly swept away by floodwaters during a storm on Tuesday.
 This after, heavy rainfall caused flooding in parts of Soweto, with several homes affected.
 Residents are facing damage to their properties as water accumulated in residential areas.
 The City of Johannesburg EMS Aquatic Rescue Unit, working alongside the SAPS K9 Unit, recovered the body.
 EMS has urged residents to avoid crossing rivers and streams during the severe thunderstorms, while parents are warned to keep children away from these areas.
 Rescue and disaster management teams remain on high alert across all seven regions of Johannesburg overnight.
 EMS spokesperson, Robert Mulaudzi says, “We are pleading with our residents to avoid crossing river streams during these severe thunderstorms which we are experiencing in most parts of the City of Johannesburg and beyond.”
